subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Scientists are able to quickly ______ the outbreak through a new immunisation.
solution: The correct answer is **"quash."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Quash"** means to suppress or put an end to something, especially forcibly. (बल प्रयोग से किसी को दबा या कुचल देना) • **Example**: *The revolt was swiftly **quashed**__ by government troops.* • The sentence suggests that scientists were able to put an end to the outbreak using a new immunisation. • The word **"quickly"** indicates that the solution was effective and efficient. • The correct answer is Option 4. **Correct sentence**: *Scientists are able to quickly __**quash**__ the outbreak through a new immunisation.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Quench" **means to satisfy one's thirst or desire, or to extinguish a fire or flame. ((पानी आदि पीकर) प्‍यास बुझाना) • **"Scatter" **means to throw or disperse something in different directions. ((लोगों या पशुओं के समूह का) तितर-बितर हो जाना, विभिन्‍न दिशाओं में तेज़ी से बिखर जाना) • **"Quest" **means a search or pursuit of something. (लंबी खोज या तलाश (कुछ दुष्‍कर वस्‍तु के लिए)) 3d:Ta73, The correct answer is **"audience". **
